business_problem: HSS needed to unify fragmented clinical, surgical, research and operational data so providers could spend less time navigating disconnected information and more time focused on patient care.
solution_summary: Hospital for Special Surgery deployed the Databricks Data + AI Platform as an enterprise-wide single source of truth so clinical, surgical, research and operational data could be used without adding more administrative burden to providers. Data from clinical activity, surgical volumes, research history and publications is consolidated into a unified lakehouse and refreshed daily, allowing teams to work from the same definitions across clinical and operational domains. HSS then built MD360 directly on Databricks to surface these insights in one application, offloading administrative tasks and letting medical teams focus on patient care. Lakebase extends the lakehouse into transactional and operational application patterns built on Bronze, Silver and Gold tables, while Unity Catalog applies centralized governance and security to sensitive healthcare assets. This architecture gives HSS a governed platform for ongoing operational innovation instead of a fragmented reporting estate.
